title: Braised Fennel with Pear and Thyme
description: Soft fennel wedges are glazed in pear and thyme.

steps.title: Set the heat
steps.text: Use the lidded HexClad wok on a medium burner.

steps.title: Build flavor
steps.text: Slice {fennel} into narrow wedges and soften in {butter} for 4 minutes.

steps.title: Cook gently
steps.text: Add {pear}, {broth} and {thyme}. Cover and simmer for 16–20 minutes until tender.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Uncover for 3 minutes and turn the wedges in the reduced juices.

notes: Make ahead: chill in shallow containers and refrigerate up to 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Freeze up to 1 month; grains and vegetables soften slightly. Fridge reheat: stir with a spoonful of water over low heat until 165°F. Freezer reheat: thaw in the fridge and warm by the same method. Dairy swap: use unsalted plant butter or dairy-free cheese as applicable. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/2 of recipe): 82 kcal, 2.0 g protein, 12.5 g total carbohydrate, 3.6 g fat, 5.0 g fiber, 69 mg sodium.
